model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, fixed existing Unsloth NF4 weights
architecture_selection: validation global token AUROC; seed42 fixed grid, family winners then three seeds; no fresh-test selection
feature_families: attention plus train-only compressed after-states and evidence-removal features
information_selection: fixed attention logistic regression, original train C=0.1, 3-fold source-group out-of-fold scores for training, full-train scores for validation/test
information_units: sentences split from output without gold labels; top-risk and random units; one request per summary per policy per arm
information_arms: evidence quotation then verdict, max64 tokens
test_metrics: clean-summary false alarm and error-summary recall at fixed validation threshold
restrictions: Only released human Evident Conflict or fully clean news
No original/new test labels in fitting or policy
No paid APIs or external LLM judge
No new gold from supplementary text
Post-generation detection, not guaranteed online prevention
New generator is a transfer condition, not same-distribution replication
runtime_amendments: Supplement batches reduced from 4 to 2 after observing approximately 7.95GB GPU residency and a sharp slowdown on longer sources. Completed records retained; same prompts, greedy decoding and 64-token ceiling. Per-record batch size and amortized time retained.

After direct and verification finished and 120 expansion records were saved, remaining expansion resumes at batch size 1. Inspection of installed bitsandbytes autograd/_functions.py confirmed single-vector 4-bit generation uses GEMV, whereas batched decode uses MatMul4Bit. This runtime change leaves prompts, weights, greedy decoding and max_new_tokens=64 fixed. Completed records retained. Timings mix batches/kernels and must not be used to rank algorithm speed; training-query state replay audit checks cached state agreement. CUDA unused cache is released between batches.
supplement_feature_plan: Prompt, generated-decision mean and last states; train-query-only PCA32 per state type; four-layer cosine and relative norm change between prompt and last state; text verdict features separately controlled. Fixed before any supplementary fitting or fresh test metrics.
capacity_control_amendment: Added while expansion was still running, before any fusion fitting or fresh test evaluation: verify_prompt_wide uses train-only PCA104 on prompt-end states. This matches the 104 internal features in verify_hidden (3xPCA32 + 8 state-change features), with zero additional generated tokens. Compare generated hidden states against both PCA32 and PCA104 prompt-only controls; verify_joint additionally contains 9 text features.
secondary_alert: Top-10-percent token-risk mean threshold calibrated on clean validation summaries, secondary to max-token alerts; fixed before fresh-test evaluation.
